mechanism: Venlafaxine is an SNRI that may increase serotonergic activity; minocycline has weak MAOI-like properties and can inhibit monoamine oxidase, creating potential for serotonin syndrome, plus additive CNS effects and photosensitivity risk.
action: Monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia); counsel on sun protection; consider alternative antibiotic if available; educate patient on warning signs.
